summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing the transfer of 3,635,260 treasury shares without consideration to participants of its equity-based incentive plans, pursuant to a board resolution announced on 2 October 2025. Following the transfer, Nokia holds 83,991,222 own shares. This is a routine administrative action related to employee share compensation, not a special situation. The filing contains no transaction terms, pricing, or strategic elements. No special-situation category applies, as the event is a standard treasury share issuance under an incentive plan.
